elements.name: night on a wide busy road
two young men walking side by side, seen from behind
shorter young man carrying a backpack
taller young man in denim jacket carrying nothing
tall concrete buildings with lit windows
thick crowd as soft dark shapes

wrong_setting: Low suburban houses with white fences, wooden utility poles and an American-style residential street with sedans read as a North American suburb, not the edge of Addis Ababa; no minibus taxis or tall concrete buildings.
notes: Regenerate as a gouache painting, not a photo: add the second, taller young man in a denim jacket beside the backpack wearer, give the backpack wearer a dark jacket over a light shirt and closed-toe plastic sandals instead of a green hoodie, jeans and leather shoes, and set them on a crowded Addis road with blue-and-white minibus taxis and tall lit concrete buildings.
